questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish present perfect from imperfect

stimulus.body: En una nota de trabajo sobre este punto se lee: « Revisábamos los datos » La nota ofrece cuatro afirmaciones posibles; solo una se desprende de lo que el texto dice realmente.

answer.exemplar: Hemos revisado presents a completed review with present relevance for the plan. Revisábamos would describe an ongoing or habitual past action without that link. The plan needs the completed result, so present perfect is correct.

questions.explanation: Present perfect links a completed action to the present. Imperfect describes ongoing or habitual past actions. The plan focuses on the completed result, so present perfect fits.
questions.hint: Decide whether the action is completed with present relevance.

Si hay errores, los corregiremos, but this is also first conditional

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: all three sentences are first conditionals, but the question asks which one is a first conditional and option A is the first listed. On that basis "Si terminamos hoy, enviaremos el informe, real condition with future result" is the supported choice. Option B ("Si hay errores, los corregiremos, but this is also first…") fails because it confuses a second example with the answer; Option C ("Si el director aprueba, publicaremos los resultados, but this…") fails because it confuses a third example with the answer; Option D ("None, because first conditionals use present subjunctive") fails because it misstates the first conditional structure.
